_comment: How ghmes/signal snapshots (the format sent by the MQTT administrator) are read; see app/ingestion/ghmes.py. Fields marked TO CONFIRM are assumptions: the sample contained only zeros under 通讯故障. Check a capture with: python scripts/ingest_mqtt.py --file data/mqtt/ghmes.example.jsonl --dry-run
_station_map: optional signalCode -> station id; without it the id is the start of signalName (AS01-三废区 -> AS01)
_codes: TO CONFIRM with the MQTT administrator: the meaning of every status code. Assumed: 0 normal, 1 level-1 alarm, 2 level-2 alarm, 3 fault, 4 offline (the prototype's 总状态 filter: 正常 / 一级报警 / 二级报警 / 故障); power_status 0 mains, 1 on battery. Raw codes are also stored (power_status, carbon_sampler, tritium_sampler).
_proposed_channels: battery_voltage ... rainfall above are NOT in the administrator's sample. The backup-power and rain rules need them; the simulator publishes them under these names. Ask the administrator to add them (or rename them here to the real fieldNames).
